title: PremiumPaymentEvent
description: Provider-independent canonical payment event published by the Payments Integration squad (v1.0). Contains zero payer PII.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version of this canonical event.

eventId.description: Meridian-generated unique identifier for this event.

correlationId.description: End-to-end correlation ID propagated from the incoming request.

providerEventId.description: Original event or notification ID sent by the provider.

providerTransactionId.description: Stable payment/charge/transaction identifier at the provider.

idempotencyKey.description: Deduplication key computed according to the provider's retry semantics.

amount.description: Decimal amount in major currency units with two decimal places.

amountRefunded.description: Refunded amount in major currency units when provided.

statusChangedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the payment state changed at the provider.

receivedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when Meridian accepted the webhook.

reasonCode.description: Provider failure or reversal reason code, if applicable.
